title: Inn
wikitext:
An '''inn''' is generally any establishment with an [[innkeeper]] that may serve as a binding point for [[:hearthstone]]s. In a broader sense, inns often contain many more defining amenities including [[Drink vendors|drink]] and [[food]] [[vendor]]s, [[stable master]]s, [[mailbox]]es, [[trainer]]s, and [[quest giver]]s, among others.
